qualification.details: Controller of Examinations: A Master's degree with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven point scale; 15 years of teaching and research experience in approved College/Institution/University of which eight years as Reader/Associate Professor OR 15 years of administrative experience of which 8 years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent. Professor cum Director, Centre for Distance and Online Education: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline with minimum 10 research publications and total research score of 120; Minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college. Dean-College Development Council: A Master's degree in Arts/Science or Humanities with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade; Experience of at least 15 years in Teaching/Research or both of which at least 2 years as Head of a Department or Principal; Ph.D qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Madras University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.unom.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Madras University for various prestigious administrative and academic positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts include Controller of Examinations, Professor cum Director (Centre for Distance and Online Education), and Dean (College Development Council).

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different leadership and academic posts in the university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via post to the university address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in application forms is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Controller of Examinations post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Controller of Examinations post is not more than 55 years.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Dean-College Development Council?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Arts, Science, or Humanities with at least 55% marks, a Ph.D qualification, and 15 years of teaching/research experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/Others and Rs. 250/- for SC/SC-A/ST/DAP candidates, paid via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the filled-in application form?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Convener, VC-Convener Committee (by Designation only), University of Madras, Centenary Buildings, Chepauk, Chennai - 600 005.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Madras University?
faq.answer: The official website to download notification and application forms is http://www.unom.ac.in.
